chat:
User: build me an app to track my expenses
AI: Sure! I'll set up a simple expense tracker with React and a small Express server. Here is the code...
User: it's not working
AI: Could you tell me what is happening? An error message or what you expected would help.
User: the page is blank. fix it
AI: A blank page often means a JavaScript error. Please open the browser console and share what it says.
User: idk how. just make it work and also add charts and login and dark mode
AI: That is a lot at once. Let's fix the blank page first, then add features one by one.
User: now it shows but when I add an expense and refresh it's gone
AI: The data lives in memory, so a refresh loses it. You need to store it somewhere permanent.
User: ok add a database

patterns: asks for many features at once
asks for a whole app without a goal
asks for a database without saying which one
overview.strongest: the page is blank. fix it
overview.weakest: build me an app to track my expenses

items.excerpt: build me an app to track my expenses
items.why: No stack, goal, or scope is given, so the AI must guess everything and may build something unusable.
items.rewrite: Build an expense tracker using [React/Express/etc]. Goal: [add/view/delete expenses]. Stack: [list].

items.why: There is no error message or symptom, so the AI cannot know what is broken.
items.rewrite: It is not working. [paste the exact error here]. Expected: [what should happen]. Actual: [what happens].

items.excerpt: the page is blank. fix it
items.why: A blank page has many causes; without console output or file paths the AI cannot find the bug.
items.rewrite: The page is blank. Browser console says: [paste exact error here]. File: [path], lines: [start]-[end].

items.excerpt: idk how. just make it work and also add charts and login and dark mode
items.why: Requesting charts, login, and dark mode together makes the change hard to review and test.
items.rewrite: Fix the blank page first. After that works, add charts. Then login. Then dark mode.

items.why: No database type, schema, or connection details are given, so the AI cannot implement it correctly.
items.rewrite: Add a [PostgreSQL/SQLite/etc] database to store expenses. Schema: [table and columns]. Connection: [env var or placeholder].
